items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: I’m glad you brought up Ada’s name, your wife... I’m very lucky to have her. And we just work together really well.

ctx.x: It’s disappeared in the fact that it’s all, you know what you see behind me. I’ve maybe done 500 sessions here at home with Ada or maybe I’ll add a part. But it’s all piecemeal. There are very few studios even in New York, there are only some small studios left. One by one all the studios that could actually house a whole group have fallen by the wayside. And everything now is just technology.
But you said — you’re pointing behind you and you’ve done 500 sessions, is that things that they send you the tracks?
